newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open 0.10 cent weaker.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open 0.10 cent weaker.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open 0.10 cent per lb lower on Thursday based on market orders at 1016 EDT, traders said.
An unimpressive weekly export and sales report, an early close and Friday's Independence Day holiday should keep volume light, they added.
NYCE will close at 1300 EDT and will reopen on Monday, July 7.
The U.S. Department of Agriculture said new sales of upland cotton for the week ended June 26 reached 63,200 480-lb bales, for the 1997/98 crop.
The report is not likely to nudge the market out of its recent trading range between support at 76.10 cents, and resistance at 77.70-77.95 cents basis the December contract.
NYCE said five notices were issued today, bringing the total to date to 767 notices.
